entries.name: Disaster Case Analysis
entries.intent: Evaluate understanding of disaster case details and correct interpretations.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 재해 사례를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Which of the following statements about the disaster case is correct?
variationTips: Change the disaster type or details in the views.

entries.name: Safety Checklist Analysis
entries.intent: Assess knowledge of safety equipment and procedures from a checklist.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 ◯◯기업 현장 안전 점검 체크 리스트의 일부이다. 이를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
judgmentAxes: Correctness of safety equipment and procedures
templates: Which of the following statements about the safety checklist is correct?
variationTips: Alter the safety equipment or procedures in the views.

entries.name: Machine Safety Accident Types
entries.intent: Identify and match types of machine safety accidents.
entries.stemPattern: [사례 1]과 [사례 2]의 기계 안전사고의 종류로 바르게 짝지은 것은?
templates: Match the types of machine safety accidents for [Case 1] and [Case 2].
variationTips: Change the cases or accident types.

entries.name: Report Analysis on Safety Measures
entries.intent: Evaluate understanding of safety measures and accident causes from a report.
entries.stemPattern: 위 보고서를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
judgmentAxes: Correctness of safety measures and accident analysis
templates: Which of the following statements about the report is correct?
variationTips: Modify the safety measures or accident causes in the views.

entries.name: Fire Case Report Analysis
entries.intent: Assess understanding of fire case details and appropriate responses.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 화재 사례 보고서를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 고른 것은?
judgmentAxes: Correctness of fire type and response
templates: Which of the following statements about the fire case report is correct?
variationTips: Change the fire details or responses in the views.

entries.name: Accident Cause and Prevention Analysis
entries.intent: Evaluate understanding of accident causes and prevention strategies from a report.
entries.stemPattern: 위 보고서를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
judgmentAxes: Correctness of accident cause analysis and prevention
templates: Which of the following statements about the report is correct?
variationTips: Alter the accident causes or prevention strategies in the views.

entries.name: Accident Prevention Step Identification
entries.intent: Identify the most appropriate activity for a given step in accident prevention.
entries.stemPattern: 위 보고서의 사고 예방 5단계 중 (가)에 해당하는 활동으로 가장 적절한 것은?
templates: What is the most appropriate activity for step (가) in accident prevention?
variationTips: Change the step or activities to choose from.

entries.name: Report Analysis on Safety Implementations
entries.intent: Assess understanding of safety implementations and their effectiveness from a report.
entries.stemPattern: 위 보고서를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Which of the following statements about the report is correct?
variationTips: Modify the safety implementations or their descriptions in the views.

entries.name: Tool and Result Matching
entries.intent: Match tools used in activities with the results achieved, focusing on reduction in accidents.
entries.stemPattern: 위 보고서에서 활동 결과를 나타낸 도구와 활동 전보다 활동 후 가장 높은 비율로 재해가 감소한 분기를 바르게 짝지은 것은?
judgmentAxes: Correct matching of tools and results
templates: Match the tool with the result showing the highest reduction in accidents post-activity.
variationTips: Change the tools or results to be matched.

entries.name: International Agreement Identification
entries.intent: Identify the most appropriate international agreement related to the given article.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 기사와 관련된 국제 협약으로 가장 적절한 것은?
templates: The article discusses [topic]. Which international agreement is most relevant?
variationTips: Vary the topic of the article to cover different international issues.

entries.name: Industrial Evolution Analysis
entries.intent: Determine the most appropriate conclusion based on the production products and methods from different periods.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 (가)～(다) 시기 공업의 생산품 및 생산 방식을 나타낸 것이다. 이를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?
templates: Based on the production methods and products from period (가) to (다), what can be concluded?
variationTips: Change the periods or types of products to explore different industrial changes.

entries.name: Product Development Suitability
entries.intent: Identify the most suitable product that meets the competition's entry criteria.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 신제품 개발 경진 대회 안내문이다. 이 대회의 출품 기준에 적합한 제품으로 가장 적절한 것은?
templates: Which product best meets the competition's entry criteria?
variationTips: Alter the criteria to test different aspects of product suitability.

entries.name: Eco-friendly Building Description
entries.intent: Select the most appropriate description of an eco-friendly building case.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 친환경 건물 건축 사례에 대한 설명으로 가장 적절한 것은?
templates: What is the most accurate description of this eco-friendly building case?
variationTips: Include different eco-friendly features to assess understanding.

entries.name: Job Posting Content Analysis
entries.intent: Determine the correct information that can be inferred from the job posting.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 채용 공고를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것은?
templates: What can be correctly inferred from this job posting?
variationTips: Change the job details to test different inference skills.

entries.name: Venture Product Development Analysis
entries.intent: Select the correct conclusions from the venture company's product development case.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 벤처 기업 제품 개발 사례를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Choose the correct conclusions from the venture product development case.
variationTips: Include different venture scenarios to test various aspects of product development.

entries.name: Factory Accident Report Analysis
entries.intent: Identify the correct analysis from the factory accident report.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 ○○공장 재해 발생 실태 보고서의 일부이다. 이를 분석한 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Select the correct analysis from the factory accident report.
variationTips: Vary the types of accidents to explore different safety issues.

entries.name: Environmental Article Analysis
entries.intent: Determine the appropriate conclusions from the environmental pollution article.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 환경오염 관련 기사를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 적절한 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: What are the appropriate conclusions from the environmental pollution article?
variationTips: Include different pollution scenarios to test understanding of environmental issues.

entries.name: Production System Dialogue Analysis
entries.intent: Identify the appropriate conclusions from the dialogue about production information systems.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 A～C기업의 생산 정보 시스템 및 생산 시스템의 적용 사례에 대한 대화 장면이다. 이를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 적절한 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: What are the appropriate conclusions from the dialogue about production systems?
variationTips: Change the systems or companies to explore different technological applications.
